skill.name: workflow-interactive-dev
skill.description: Guides developers through building interactive response nodes for FastGPT workflows, including types, dispatch logic, UI components, history handling, and tests.
skill.summary: Build FastGPT interactive workflow nodes with coordinated backend and frontend changes.

如果节点需要在工具调用中使用,设置 `isTool: true`。

content.value_statement: Interactive workflow nodes require coordinated backend, frontend, history, and localization changes. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused implementation guide for FastGPT interactive responses.
actual_capabilities: Explains the existing FastGPT interactive node architecture and supported node types.
Lists backend files that need type, template, dispatch, callback, and runtime updates.
Shows frontend component patterns for chat interactions and workflow editor nodes.
Describes state handling for isEntry, skip queues, submitted values, and history rewriting.
Provides a testing checklist for display, persistence, workflow resume, outputs, and localization.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not modify files by itself.
Examples use placeholder names that must be adapted to the target node.
It assumes the FastGPT project structure matches the referenced paths.
It does not provide production validation logic for each custom input type.

use_cases.title: Add a Custom Interaction Node
use_cases.description: Plan the backend and frontend changes needed for a new FastGPT workflow interaction.

use_cases.title: Review Workflow Resume Behavior
use_cases.description: Check that a pause-and-resume node preserves entry state, history, and output values correctly.

use_cases.title: Prepare UI and Localization Work
use_cases.description: Identify chat components, workflow editor components, and translation files that need updates.

prompt_templates.title: Map Required Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new node.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list every FastGPT file I should edit for a new interactive workflow node named approvalCheck.

prompt_templates.title: Design Node Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline the dispatch flow for a FastGPT interactive node that pauses for user approval and resumes with a result value.

prompt_templates.title: Create Frontend Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan the chat interaction component and workflow editor component for a multi-field FastGPT node.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Implementation Completeness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my FastGPT interactive node implementation for missing runtime, history, localization, and test coverage changes.

output_examples.input: I need to add a payment confirmation interaction to a FastGPT workflow.
output_examples.output: A file-by-file implementation plan covering the node type, template, dispatch handler, callback registration, chat UI, editor UI, history handling, and translations.

output_examples.input: My interactive node pauses but does not resume correctly.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist focused on entry state, last interaction type, submitted values, history rewriting, and workflow resume behavior.

output_examples.input: Prepare tests for a new form-based workflow node.
output_examples.output: A targeted test plan covering editor rendering, saved configuration, frontend submission, backend resume, node outputs, error cases, and language coverage.

best_practices: Keep backend types, dispatch output, frontend form values, and node outputs aligned.
Reset entry state only after the user submission is processed successfully.
Test the node in editor, chat, resume, history, output, and localization flows.
anti_patterns: Adding only a frontend component without registering backend dispatch behavior.
Parsing submitted user input without validation or error handling.
Forgetting history and resume helpers when the node must work across pauses.

faq.question: Does this skill create FastGPT code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples for developers to apply in the FastGPT codebase.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What kind of node does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on workflow nodes that pause execution, collect user input, and then resume execution.

faq.question: Does it cover frontend work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers chat interaction components and workflow editor node components.

faq.question: Does it cover backend runtime behavior?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers type definitions, dispatch handlers, callback registration, entry state, and history handling.

faq.question: Can I use it outside FastGPT?
faq.answer: Only as a conceptual reference. The paths and examples are specific to the FastGPT repository.
